recommendations.recommendation: May be considered in patients with symptomatic HFrEF who cannot tolerate any of an ACE‑I, an ARB, or ARNI (or they are contraindicated) to reduce the risk of death.
recommendations.context_text: Hydralazine and isosorbide dinitrate may be considered in patients with symptomatic HFrEF who cannot tolerate any of an ACE-I, an ARB, or ARNI (or they are contraindicated) to reduce the risk of death.

recommendations.recommendation: May be considered in patients with symptomatic HFrEF in sinus rhythm despite treatment with an ACE‑I (or ARNI), a beta‑blocker and an MRA, to reduce the risk of hospitalization (both all‑cause and HF hospitalizations).
recommendations.context_text: Digoxin may be considered in patients with symptomatic HFrEF in sinus rhythm despite treatment with an ACE-I (or ARNI), a beta-blocker and an MRA, to reduce the risk of hospitalization (both all-cause and HF hospitalizations).

abbreviations.HFrEF: heart failure with reduced ejection fraction
